title: Rewards of Quran Recitation Effort
summary: Even those who struggle while reciting the Quran are promised double the reward, emphasizing its importance in a Muslim's life.
translation: Incorporate the recitation of the Holy Quran into our routines such that it becomes indispensable in our lives. This should define a Muslim. The Hadith leaves no excuse for someone claiming inability to read the Quran. The Hadith promises double reward for a person who struggles to recite properly. According to a Hadith narrated by Hazrat Aisha Siddiqa (may Allah be pleased with her), the Prophet (peace be upon him) said that a person who reads the Quran expertly will be among the noble, righteous angels on the Day of Judgment. However, a person who reads with difficulty and effort will receive double reward: one for the recitation and another for the effort put into it.
